title: Use BaseApp's new PO Matching module in E-Documents
summary: E-Documents now leverages BaseApp's new PO Matching module to support one-to-many matching and receiving at invoice for two-way matches, with additional warnings for amount mismatches and expanded matching fields.
key_points: Integrates BaseApp's new PO Matching API surface into E-Document creation workflow
Enables one-to-many purchase order line matching against invoices
Supports receiving at invoice time for two-way matches
Adds warning notifications when invoice amounts don't match purchase orders
Expands page fields to show more matching information for Payables Agent decisions
quote: Uptakes the new API surface for BaseApp's PO Matching module at E-Document creation.
